items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Don had Barry Galbraith -- on every record date he made. Every record date Don Redman had, if he could have Barry, he'd have Barry there.

ctx.x: -- with Claude Thornhill. Oh, what a great rhythm section.
Oh, yes. Well, you know, Don loved him, you know. Don had Barry Galbraith --
I loved him, too. I'll love him forever.
